DATE OF EVENT: Wednesday 15 July 2026 — Starmer's final PMQs. This is NOT a Saturday development.

REPORTED CONTENT AND QUOTES (attributed to Sir Keir Starmer):
- "This is the end of my political journey" — though he plans to remain a backbench MP for now.
- "I am proud to leave this country in better shape than I found it."
- On supporting his successor: "I shall give my support privately if asked for, not publicly
  when not asked for."
- Said "I love you" to wife Victoria and their two teenage children in the viewing gallery,
  before a final "Goodbye."
- MPs from all sides applauded, many rising for a standing ovation.
- Cited as achievements: stronger protections for working people, a reduction in child poverty,
  a law designed to stop official cover-ups after tragedies, and higher defence spending.

RELATED: Kemi Badenoch reportedly accused Burnham of "scurrying away" during the same session.
